page.title: Webhooks
page.subtitle: Send events from this workspace to your own systems as they happen. Each delivery is a signed JSON POST, retried when your server does not answer.
page.empty: Add an endpoint to receive events such as a new contact or a deal moving stage.
page.noAccess: You do not have access to webhooks.
page.loadFailed: The webhooks could not be loaded.
page.deleteMessage: {name} stops receiving events and its delivery log is removed. This cannot be undone.
page.deleteFailed: The webhook could not be deleted. Try again.
page.toggleFailed: The change could not be saved. Try again.
page.testError: The test could not be sent. Try again.
